# Fixture — archetype roster (F2 landed)

Small, synthetic stand-in for `docs/design/content/archetypes.md` after PR #133: the harbour-master
row carries the renamed byname.

| slug | name | one-line identity | level band | hostile? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `giant-rat` | Giant Rat † | Eats the spilled grain. | 1–3 | yes |
| `drove-cur` | Drove Cur | Feral dog of the dry-stone walls. | 1–3 | yes |
| `cliff-breaker` | Cliff Breaker | Breaks the coast road's falls. | 3–5 | yes |

## Naming — derivation notes

| name | derivation |
|---|---|
| Drove Cur | Common: *drove* + *cur*, a working dog |
| Gaelrek | *gael* (water, flow) + *rek* (administer, keep in place) — "keeper of the water" |
